name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
label: Quest
description: With the shrunken head delivered in A Strange Request, Neeru Fireblade hands you the herbs and asks you to carry them to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas…
intro: With the shrunken head delivered in A Strange Request, Neeru Fireblade hands you the herbs and asks you to carry them to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas, along with word that Neeru is satisfied with the head.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here are the herbs, friend. Take them to Witch Doctor Uzer'i.
Please let him know that I am satisfied with the shrunken head.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is just what I need to prepare the muisek vessel, friend. Soon we will see if my latest incantations prove to be as powerful as I had hoped.
Please, a moment. I must perform the ritual and apply the herbs.
